{{Aquarius}}
Aquarius 11 is the 67th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 11th day of Aquarius, and it is a Thursday. It corresponds to ISO week 10, weekday 4.

Its informal Japanese name is 3宮11日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 67|Chapter 67]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152087}}.
